profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Cruise
profile.summary:
My experience mostly centers around software engineering related to hardware design and implementation. My work experiences are heavy in Linux support for custom hardware, Linux device drivers and embedded Linux systems, and board bring-up.

I also manage and maintain Icarus Verilog, a very popular open source Verilog compiler. I have worked on Icarus Verilog professionally and on a volunteer basis.

My specialties include: Linux device drivers, embedded linux development, Icarus Verilog, C/C++, Verilog, Mac OS X, QT, Xilinx FPGA.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I'm the chief developer and the original author for the open source project Icarus Verilog, and related tools. I manage a small and fluid team of volunteer developers.

positions.title: Archery Coach
positions.description: I am a level-3 certified archery coach. I specialize in recurve and barebow disciplines, and one-on-one coaching and instruction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Devices drivers, firmware, embedded Linux, hardware bring-up and debug. I am the principle embedded software engineer, responsible for the drivers for use by customers and internally. I am responsible for firmware (linux based) running on embedded processors, and host-side APIs that customers use to interact with our boards. I also provide Verilog and C/C++ test benches for the verification of FPGA designs. I develop and support hardware/software co-design tools as well as the test benches that these tools enable.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked as a software engineer, developing large scale distributed data management systems for industrial customers.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteer as a telescope operator for the observatories at the CSSC.
Chief Archery instructor for Redwood Bowmen archery club, providing monthly classes for the East Bay Regional Parks district.
